mandatory_rules.instruction: When accelerating delivery, schedule independent non-conflicting tasks in the same execution batch; serialize only dependencies, provider limits, or conflicting write scope.

For foundational capabilities, research GitHub and mature reusable solutions first, prefer Direct Use then Wrap/Adapt then Build, produce a runnable PoC when reasonably possible, and give explicit rejection evidence before a custom build.
Treat this brief as the copy-ready execution contract; do not rely on README memory or unstated rules.
Claim an AI/provider is running only with current real execution evidence; otherwise report that none is proven running.
Prioritize user-visible usable progress over generalized infrastructure; never present internal READY/PASS as user-facing completion.
Finish with every mandatory ADM status field exactly as listed in this brief.
Use the configured cloud/GitHub runtime SSOT for persistent project state; local state is only for approved runtime, scratch, cache, login, or session needs.
Preserve the canonical AI, Project, Task, Conversation, and Session identity in reports and handoffs.
